ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AD$ bisects $\angle BAC$ and intersects $BC$ at point $D$, $DE\perp AB$ with the foot at $E$. If $BC=4$ and $DE=1.6$, what is the length of $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AD$ bisects $\angle BAC$, $DE\perp AB$, and $\angle C=90^\circ$,\\
it follows that $CD=DE$,\\
Since $DE=1.6$,\\
it follows that $CD=1.6$,\\
therefore $BD=BC-CD=4-1.6=\boxed{2.4}$.
